description: Returns current US store offers for one Divux product id, ranked by price (item plus shipping where the store lists it, tax excluded). The default is the top 3 offers; detail set to true returns up to 8. Each offer includes a link to its Divux page. Official CPSC recall notices that mention the product are included when some exist; their absence does not mean a product has no recall. Links may be paid links; the order is by price only. Divux does not check out. An empty offer list means no matching offer was found. Applies to questions about current prices and stores for one specific product.

condition.description: new, used or any. 'used' includes open-box and refurbished. Default is new.

detail.description: false returns the top 3 offers. true returns up to 8.

product_id.description: Product id from a product search
